title: Part Status offers Active and Inactive, set to the saved status
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have an active part, part A, and an inactive part, part B, at the test location.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type part A's part number in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Cancel.
  4. Click the Inactive tab.
  5. Type part B's part number in the Search box.
  6. Click the part B row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Part A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Under Part Number a "Part Status" choice offers two options, Active and Inactive, with Active selected.

Step 3:

  • The window closes.

Step 4:

  • The Inactive tab is selected.

Step 5:

  • Part B is listed.

Step 6:

  • Part Status has Inactive selected.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10826 (Story 13, The Part Dialog)

  • S13-R20: “When editing, a "Part Status" choice offers two options, Active and Inactive, set to the part's saved status. A user without the 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' permission sees the choice disabled.”
